svg.title: SkillScout architecture, step by step
svg.desc: Every evening Airflow, running in Docker, runs one ingestion DAG per source: it makes sure the landing volume exists, fetches the API and lands raw JSON, purges expired Himalayas files, and checks the run, which updates an Asset. Once all three job sources have landed, transform_and_build runs the Databricks Job transform_jobs (bronze with Auto Loader, reference data, Himalayas retention, silver exchange rates, silver jobs, silver skills, checks), then dbt deps, a source freshness check on silver and dbt build, which builds staging, intermediate, marts and history models: the gold layer. Failed tasks send e-mails through Gmail. The Power BI service refreshes its model from gold at 19:00 UTC; the report is published to the web and embedded in a GitHub Pages site that anyone can open.
